answers.explanation: Strict priority: the top non-empty queue always goes first.
If the high queue never empties, the low queue is never sent: starvation.
It keeps cycling, so no class starves.
Each class's share is proportional to its weight.
Unused share is shared out among the classes that do have packets. The link isn't left idle while anyone waits.
Class is any header field. The type of service byte exists for exactly this.
Put voice in the high queue. As long as voice doesn't fill the link, the bulk traffic still gets through.
